limitations: Computational sensitivity on four frozen wire DTOs; no observed trajectory data or physical accuracy inference.
Both ordinary and event integration tolerances change together; root-only probes retain integration scale 0.01.
Coarse production scalars and event quantities use their existing engine definitions; no canonical continuous-time peak recomputation.
Telemetry uses display cadence (every fifth macro step before apogee, every macro step before rail exit/after apogee), display rounding, and decimation to at most 5000 retained samples.
Telemetry is bounded/decimated, not silently truncated; original full-series point counts cannot be recovered from these DTOs. All retained runs cover touchdown.
Retained-sample peak differences include rounding and changing sample selection; no index-aligned trajectory norm or continuous maximum is inferred.
No monotonic-convergence or universal numerical/physical error bound.
Production PASS validity and safety flags retain their legacy meanings; this diagnostic does not certify primary use.
RSS is sampled process-tree resident memory, not a kernel-enforced memory cap.
